paper_title: First Results from ABRACADABRA-10 cm: A Search for Sub-$μ$eV Axion Dark Matter
notes: First ABRACADABRA-10cm results. 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma ranging from 1.4e-10 GeV^-1 (best point) to 3.3e-9 GeV^-1 over mass range 3.1e-10 - 8.3e-9 eV (frequency 75 kHz - 2 MHz). Full exclusion curve is in Fig. 3 but only endpoint/extremum values are quoted numerically in text; the two data points bracket the limit range but the actual curve varies with mass.
